name: Amber Woodruff
message: Levi working with us was the most beneficial and pivotal decision that we have made regarding our short term rental. Not only did he spring board our business to where it is today, but the best part was working with him. He was super personable, humble, easy to communicate with and built extreme excitement around our launch video! His videos capture the atmosphere and vision you have for your property. We will 100% be calling him again for our future rentals! Hands down one of the most talented videographers.

name: @modcabins
message: Levi, Thank you so much for your post. Your promotion of our cabins has helped us a lot. You do great work!

name: River Rock House
message: The video you created of RiverRock is absolutely perfect and we couldn’t have imagined anything better! We have worked so hard to get our direct booking site up and running and we had zero interest in it until your video posted, and since then we’ve gotten at least 1 direct booking every day. Just wanted you to know that it’s definitely made a tangible difference for us and we are so grateful!

name: @littlerivertinyhouse
message: Dorothy found us on YouTube per @levimkelly ‘s video and wanted to spend her 80th birthday with us!
